agency: Brevard Public Schools (via Florida Today/Yahoo News)
text: Brevard Public Schools will stay closed for a third day in a row on Wednesday, Nov. 4. A district spokesperson said campus damage, flooded roads and water service outages mean the district can't open safely. District crews are continuing inspections, repairs and cleanup to get campuses ready to reopen.

In its 3:25 p.m. Tuesday traffic update, the City of Melbourne lists only two current closures: John Rodes Blvd south of Dow Rd, and Sunlake Rd at Babcock St. John Rodes Blvd has reopened between Eau Gallie Blvd and Dow Rd. Drive with extreme caution and do not drive around barricades.

A flood warning is in effect until 9:30 a.m. Wednesday for some of the hardest-hit parts of Brevard County. Standing water and multiple road closures are still making travel hazardous. Little more rain is expected, but even a small amount could cause problems where floodwater has not drained. Residents in flood-prone areas should stay cautious, avoid driving through standing water and check for road closures before heading out.
